How Does It Work?

HydraFacial Vortex Technology

Patented vortex suction and exfoliation deeply cleanses the scalp â removing dead skin, excess oil, product buildup, and debris from clogged follicles. This creates a clean, refreshed scalp surface that can breathe and absorb nutrients effectively.

Keravive Peptide Complex

A proprietary blend of biomimetic growth factors, peptides, niacinamide, and Vitamin B5 is infused into the cleansed scalp. This nourishes follicles, stimulates circulation, balances the scalp microbiome, and promotes thicker, healthier hair growth from the root.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Is Keravive painful?

Not at all! It's a completely pain-free, relaxing experience. You'll feel gentle suction on your scalp and a cooling sensation from the solutions. Many clients find it very soothing.

How soon will I see results?

Is it safe for color-treated hair?

Can I use it with other hair treatments?

Absolutely! Keravive pairs perfectly with QR678, PRP, mesotherapy, and exosome therapy. It's also ideal before and after hair transplant to optimize scalp health.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Does it work for hair loss?

Is it safe for color-treated hair?

Yes! Keravive is safe for all hair types, including color-treated, chemically processed, and even extensions or braids. It won't affect your color or dye.

What's in the take-home spray?

The Keravive Peptide Complex Spray contains growth factors, niacinamide, Vitamin B5, and arginine. It extends the in-office benefits by providing daily nourishment and stimulation to your scalp.
